title: Una Mirada Hacia El Futuro
content:
Título

: Una Mirada Hacia El Futuro

Fecha

: 1969

Notas

: Título original:

Looking Forward

. Traducido entre 2024-2026 por

La Conquista del Panda

 bajo licencia

CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

Fuente

: Obra original recuperada desde

archive.org


Dedicado a las personas jóvenes de todo el mundo que deben afrontar los retos del siglo XXI.


Sobre la obra


 Mirando al futuro es un libro imaginativo y fascinante en el que los autores te llevarán de viaje por la cultura y la tecnología del siglo XXI. Tras una sección introductoria en la que se analiza «lo que moldea nuestro futuro», explorarás los porqués del poco familiar, a veces alarmante, pero apasionante mundo de dentro de cien años.


 Verás esta sociedad a través de los ojos de Scott y Hella, una pareja del próximo siglo. Su vivienda está equipada con un cibernador, un dispositivo informático aparentemente mágico, pero basado en principios científicos hoy conocidos. Ayuda a regular las horas de sueño, las comunicaciones en todo el mundo, un increíble complejo de vida submarina e incluso la ingesta calórica diaria de la «joven» pareja. Son cuarentones, pero pueden esperar vivir 200 años. El mundo en el que viven Scott y Hella es un mundo que ha logrado el control total del clima, que ha desarrollado un ordenador del tamaño de un dedo que se implanta en el cerebro de cada bebé al nacer (y los bebés se incuban científicamente para que las mujeres del siglo XXI no tengan que pasar por los dolores del parto), y que ha perfeccionado la manipulación genética que permite mejorar la especie humana por medio de la ciencia.


 Económicamente, el mundo es utópico para nuestros estándares. Hace tiempo que desaparecieron los empleos, los salarios y el dinero. Nada tiene precio y las posesiones personales no son necesarias. Se ha superado el nacionalismo y se ha logrado el desarme total; la tecnología educativa ha dejado obsoletas las escuelas y los profesores. Los niños aprenden haciendo, y son independientes en este mundo amistoso a los cinco años.


 La principal fuente de esta sociedad mayor es el Centro de Correlación, «Cencor», un gigantesco complejo de ordenadores que sirve a la humanidad, pero nunca la esclaviza. Cencor regula la producción, la comunicación, el transporte y todas las demás tareas onerosas y monótonas del pasado. Esto libera a los seres humanos para que vivan experiencias creativas y estimulantes en lugar de vidas vacías de ocio sin sentido.


 Obviamente, este libro es especulativo, pero está sólidamente basado en los avances científicos que ahora se conocen. Y como dicen los autores:


Entenderás mejor este libro si eres de las que ven el hoy como un peldaño entre el ayer y el mañana.


Necesitarás ser sensible a las injusticias, a las oportunidades de felicidad perdidas y a los agudos conflictos que caracterizan a nuestra civilización del siglo XX. Si tu mente es capaz de sopesar nuevas ideas y evaluarlas con perspicacia, este libro es para ti.


No tenemos una bola de cristal. ...Queremos que introduzcas nuestras ideas en tu propio ordenador, para que puedas encontrar ideas aún mejores que puedan contribuir a moldear el futuro de nuestra civilización.


Sobre los autores


 Jacque Fresco trabajó como diseñador industrial durante treinta años, diseñando todo tipo de equipos, desde casas prefabricadas hasta automóviles, equipos electrónicos y médicos, sistemas de ingeniería ergonómica y cientos de productos comerciales e inventos. Ha diseñado y patentado artículos tan diversos como una estructura de ala de avión revolucionaria, patentada por la USAAF, y películas tridimensionales que no requieren el «uso de gafas especiales». Se han publicado numerosos artículos y fotografías sobre su trabajo en muchas revistas y periódicos. Ha ejercido de asesor técnico en varias películas, incluida una de las primeras sobre estaciones espaciales y un viaje a la Luna titulada «Project Moon Base». Vive en Miami.


 Kenneth S. Keyes, Jr., es un hombre polifacético. Estudió en la Universidad de Duke y se licenció en la Universidad de Miami, con la especialidad principal en psicología y la secundaria en música. Entre sus aficiones se encuentran el arte, la música sinfónica, la navegación a vela —vive a bordo de un yate de 71 pies llamado Caprice— y la escritura; es autor de

Cómo desarrollar tu capacidad de razonamiento

 y

Cómo vivir más tiempo, con más fuerza y más delgado

. Ha impartido clases en la División de Cursos Nocturnos de la Universidad de Miami …

title: Генри Дэвид Торо - О гражданском неповиновении
content:
Автор

: Генри Дэвид Торо

Название

: О гражданском неповиновении

Дата

: 1849

Дополнительная информация

: Перевод: 3. Е. Александрова

Оригинальное название: "Civil Disobedience"

Источник

: https://biblioteka-online.org/book/o-grazdanskom-nepovinovenii/reader


 Я всецело согласен с утверждением: «лучшее правительство — то, которое правит как можно меньше», — и хотел бы, чтобы оно осуществлялось быстрее и более систематически. Осуществленное, оно сводится в конце концов — и за это я тоже стою — к девизу: Лучшее правительство то, которое не правит вовсе, а когда люди будут к этому готовы, то именно такие правительства у них и будут. Правительство является в лучшем случае всего лишь средством, но большинство правительств обычно—а иногда и все они—являются средствами недейственными. Возражения, приводившиеся против постоянной армии, — а они многочисленны и вески и должны бы восторжествовать — могут быть выдвинуты также и против постоянного правительства. Постоянная армия — это всего лишь рука постоянного правительства. Само правительство, являющееся только формой, в которой народу угодно осуществлять свою волю, тоже ведь может быть обращено во зло, прежде чем народ совершит через него то, что хочет. Доказательством служит нынешняя война в Мексике, затеянная небольшой группой людей, которые использовали постоянное правительство в качестве своего орудия, ибо народ с самого начала не согласился бы на такую меру.


А что такое американское правительство, как не традиция, хотя и недавняя, пытающаяся себя увековечить, но ежеминутно теряющая что-то от своей чистоты? Оно не обладает жизненной силой даже одного человека, ибо один человек может подчинить его своей воле. Для народа это нечто вроде деревянного ружья. Но от этого оно не менее необходимо; ибо народу нужен тот или иной сложный механизм, и притом шумный, чтобы чувствовать, что у него действительно есть правительство. Правительства, таким образом, доказывают, как легко удается для их же пользы обманывать людей и как они обманывают себя сами. Отличная вещь, мы все должны это признать; однако наше правительство еще ни разу само не способствовало никакому делу иначе, как быстро устраняясь с дороги. Не оно охраняет свободу страны. Не оно заселяет Запад. Не оно распространяет просвещение. Все это достигнуто благодаря чертам, присущим американскому народу, и достижений было бы больше, если бы правительство иной раз не мешало этому. Ибо правительство — это средство, с помощью которого люди хотели бы не мешать друг другу, и, как уже было сказано, это средство всегда наиболее действенно, когда меньше всего мешает своим подданным. Если бы торговля не была по своей природе резиновой, она никогда не смогла бы перепрыгивать все препятствия, какие воздвигают на ее пути законодатели; и если бы судить их только по результатам их действий, не учитывая их намерений, их следовало бы карать как тех злоумышленников, которые кладут посторонние предметы на рельсы.


Если говорить конкретно и как гражданин, а не как те, кто отрицает всякое правительство, я требую не немедленной отмены правительства, но его немедленного улучшения. Пусть каждый объявит, какое правительство он готов уважать, и это уже будет шагом к такому правительству.


Когда народ, получив в свои руки власть, передает ее большинству и долгое время позволяет ему править, это происходит не потому, что оно правит наиболее справедливо, и не потому, что это представляется всего справедливее по отношению к меньшинству, но по той простой причине, что оно физически сильнее. Но правительство, где правит большинство, не может быть основано на справедливости даже в том ограниченном смысле, в каком ее понимают люди. Неужели невозможно такое правительство, где о правде и неправде судило бы не большинство, а совесть? Где большинство решало бы лишь те вопросы, к которым приложима мерка целесообразности? Неужели гражданин должен, хотя бы на миг или в малейшей степени, передавать свою совесть в руки законодателя? К чему тогда каждому человеку совесть? Я считаю, что мы должны быть сперва людьми, а потом уж подданными правительства. Желательно воспитывать уважение не столько к закону, сколько к справедливости. Единственная обязанность, какую я имею право на себя брать, — это обязанность всегда поступать так, как мне кажется правильным. author: Unknown
title: Asher - What Queerness Means To Me
content:
Author

: Asher

Title

: What Queerness Means To Me

Date

: July 7, 2011

Notes

: retrieved via the internet archive from

https://web.archive.org/web/20150228140452/http://www.tranarchism.com/2011/07/07/what-queerness-means-to-me/index.html

Source

: Retrieved on 28 Feb 2015 from

http://www.tranarchism.com/2011/07/07/what-queerness-means-to-me/index.html


 I remember playing pretend games with my brother when he was really little. For a happy ending to one epic struggle of good versus evil, he wanted all the dolls/“action figures” to “all get married together”—boys, girls, witches, dragons, demons, whatever, united in a big happy pansexual polygamous clusterfuck. I remember explaining to him that you couldn’t do that, that marriage was between two people, usually a man and a woman.


 Forgive me. I was twelve, I didn’t know any better. On the other hand he was about five, and apparently he already did.


 The innocence of children with regard to love, romance, gender, friendship and relationships is truly beautiful. They are basically open to all kinds of gender expressions and all sorts of relationships, including the queer, the polyamorous, the platonic. Best friends in preschool get engaged and even married all the time, regardless of gender (or prior mock-marital status). I remember that innocence.


 I lost it. First I was a girl, then I was heterosexual, then I was bisexual, then I was wondering if maybe I wasn’t kind of just a lesbian. Then I was polyamorous, then I was kinky, then I was pansexual. I was submissive, then a switch. Then I was gender questioning, then FTM, and gay. I was a transman, and then a trans man. I was homoflexible, or just a faggot. I was transsexual then transgender then transsexual again and finally just trans. Today I’m a trans fem/androgynous male who uses he/him/his pronouns and doesn’t like being called a man but guesses it’s better than being called a boy by strangers and who isn’t really genderqueer. I think. I may be something else tomorrow. And if you think that sounds complicated you should talk to some of my friends.


 But my own angsty odyssey of identity isn’t really what I want to talk about. I want to talk about the word queer and the world of possibility it represents to me. Queer is a term which for me recaptures the unconstrained innocence of childhood, when best friends could all get married together and we could all be fairy princesses one day and firefighters the next.


 Isn’t it weird that we’re all supposed to feel one way about friends, another about family, and another about lovers? Isn’t it strange that family is only determined by biology or sanctified by marriage and sealed with reproduction? Isn’t it odd that romance is supposed to be doomed without sex, and sex is considered pointless without romance? Isn’t it strange that we’re only supposed to feel one way about one person until death do us part?


 Queerness, to me, is about far more than homosexual attraction. It’s about a willingness to see all other taboos broken down. Sure, many of us start on this path when we first feel “same sex” or “same gender” attraction (though what is sex? And what is gender? And does anyone really have the same sex or gender as anyone else?). But queerness doesn’t stop there.


 This is a somewhat controversial stance, but to me queer means something completely different than “gay” or “lesbian” or “bisexual.” A queer person is usually someone who has come to a non-binary view of gender, who recognizes the validity of all trans identities, and who, given this understanding of infinite gender possibilities, finds it hard to define their sexuality any longer in a gender-based way. Queer people understand and support non-monogamy even if they do not engage in it themselves. They can grok being asexual or aromantic. (What does sex have to do with love, or love with sex, necessarily?) A queer can view promiscuous (protected) public bathhouse sex with strangers and complete abstinence as equally healthy.


 Queers understand that people have different relationships to their bodies. We get what it means to be stone. We know what body dysphoria is about. We understand that not everyone likes to get touched the same way or to get touched at all. We realize that people with disabilities may have different sexual needs, and that people with survivor histories often have sexual triggers. We can negotiate safe and creative ways to be intimate with people with HIV/AIDs and other …

author: Unknown
title: Signe Strömer - Ferrers grav
content:
Författare

: Signe Strömer

Titel

: Ferrers grav

Källa

: Tidningen Brand #3 1911


 (Barcelona).


 Kyrkogården här i Barcelona har många »klasser», precis som det efter vissa religiösa föreställningar måtte se ut i paradiset.


 De, vilka omfattat den allena saliggörande tron, ha självklart företrädet, vad läge, rymlighet och pomp angår. Här träffar man en rik samling vidunderliga gravstenar och åt himlen stretande mästervärk av - fuskare.


 Missfall och odöpta barn bilda en särskild avdelning.


 Och långt, långt avsides, med egen ingång och helt och hållet skild från den andra terrängen, de renlivades heliga jord, ha »libres pensadores» fått sina viloställen. Libres pensadores, därunder förstår man »kättarna», de s. k. fritänkarne samt frimurare och andra som inte ha svart på vitt att ha uppgivit andan efter föreskriven regel.


 Här är det som om luften man andas, vore renare. Ingen tillmötande uppblåsthet förnärmar ögat. Här och var märker man ett enkelt kors, i övrigt bara nischer med släta inskrifter eller frimurare-emblem.


 Vid detta »departementos» yttersta ända stöter man på en djup sumpig gruva, dit nästan aldrig en solstråle tränger. Den är omringad av en mur, för att förebygga olyckor. Några stenar äro ställda till förfogande för dem som önska blicka ned i djupet. Vid första anblicken liknar det hela en märgelgruva som snart blivit överlämnad åt sitt öde och nu måste tjäna som sophög åt de dödas torra kransar och åt smutsigt papper. Men hur förvånas man ej, när man på den eländiga lilla fläcken upptäcker små kors med söndertrasade små metallkransar. Man frågar sig ovillkorligen om också för hundar ett »departemento» blivit reserverat här.


 Men nej, detta eländiga, vattenfuktiga hål föreställer den tragiskt beryktade »fossa comuna», det är de fattiga

icke-katolikernas

 begravningsplats.


 I det ena hörnet, inklämt mellan muren och en naken grusvall, ligger en hög vissnade rosor och chrysanthemum, vissna, multna, betäckta av fuktig mögel. Om en dag någon bortslungar denna sista rest blomstjälkar, så skall platsen icke genom något skilja sig från den ohyggliga omgivningen. Ty ingen tavla, ingen inskrift förråder, vem som blev nedsänkt här i den sumpiga jorden.


 Det var natten mellan den 13 och 14 oktober 1909, som här i all hast och hemlighet en bloddrypande kista utan följe, utan sörjande blev nedburen i en ovanligt djup gruva, nedsänkt och snabbt tillskottad. På kistans lock stod på en liten metallplåt den dödes namn:

Francisko Ferrer

 - det enda som hade blivit en förtvivlad moder tillåtet att tillägna sin mördade sons minne.


 Huru många tusende hade icke gärna betygat den så smädligt undanröjde och det sista kärleksbevisat! Men de klerikala bödlarna kunde icke umbära triumfen att tillfoga den förhatade ännu i döden denna sista skymf.


 Måtte dock snart på denna ohyggliga plats resa sig en minnesstod, på vilken står skrivet: Skam åt de fega uslingar som tolererade det lömskaste av alla jesuiternas blodsdåd.

author: Battlescarred
title: Topilin, Sergei (1900–1921)
content:
A short biography of Russian anarchist Sergei Topilin, who organised a daring escape of anarchists from a Bolshevik prison.

“I first saw Sergei Topilin in 1920, at a concert in Ryazan. I saw him again in February 1921, at Kropotkin's coffin in Moscow. It was when I saw him at a concert in Ryazan that I learned he was an anarchist.” Tatiana Garaseva.

Sergei Nikolaevich Topilin was born into a peasant family in the village of Kuzminka in the Ryazan district of Russia. He attended a gymnasium (high school) in Ryazan, where he completed four classes. Under the influence of his older brother Alexander, he joined the anarchist communist movement in 1919. He was active in propaganda work in the anarchist communist group in Ryazan.

In spring 1920 he was working as director of the amateur theatre group of the Red Army garrison Kultprosveta (Cultural Enlightenment), and as a junior policeman. At the May Day rally that year in Ryazan, he was arrested for “calling on the Red Army to abandon their service and weapons, as well as for openly agitating for the overthrow of Soviet power” and imprisoned until further notice in the Ryazan prison. He was then sent to Moscow, where on 6th July, he was sentenced by the Cheka to 3 months imprisonment in a concentration camp. This must have increased his bitterness and hostility towards the Bolsheviks, as on his release he joined the All-Russian Organization of Anarchists Underground (VOAP) at the end of 1920.

Topilin attended Kropotkin’s funeral in Moscow on February 13th, 1921.

Because the Butyrka prison in Moscow was now overcrowded with anarchist and Makhnovist prisoners, it was decided to transfer some of them to provincial prisons on April 26th, 1921, including in Ryazan. Yuli Perelman, active in the VOAP, began to plan an escape of anarchist prisoners at Ryazan. He and Vladimir Potekhin travelled to Ryazan, where they contacted Topilin, F. A. Krasavchikov, and I.A. Povarikhin, the latter two also members of the Ryazan anarchist group.

The security of the provincial prisons was compromised by the abrupt notice to fill them with anarchists. In addition, Topilin knew the layout of the Ryazan prison well, due to his previous incarceration there.

As a representative of the Anarchist Black Cross, Topilin was able to gain access to the prison to deliver aid parcels. He was able to pass documents and money to anarchist prisoners. During the night of June 18th, nine anarchists escaped through a hole in the toilet wall opposite Fanya Baron’s cell. They climbed down ropes to an unguarded floor, entered the prison yard and climbed over a fence to escape. As well as Fanya Baron, the escapees included anarchists David Kogan, V.M. Kurbatov, B. E. Lilov, I.N. Gavrilov-Mikhnevich, K.Y. Pilipenko, I.V. Tarasiuk, A. E. Budov, and P. I. Khokhotva, as well as the Socialist Revolutionary, Petrov.

Topilin then went into hiding. Investigators established that the escape had been accomplished "according to a premeditated plan with the participation of the anarchist-communist Topilin, who had disappeared without a trace."

In July 1921, Topilin had moved to Moscow. Later that month, he visited an OAU flat to meet with Potekhin, Kurbatov, and others. On August 16th, together with Kurbatov, Ivan Bubnov and others, he took part in an expropriation of the cash desk of the Main Military Engineering Directorate. They seized 100 million roubles, but were forced to abandon it as they were pursued. One of the group, Trofim Silantyev, was surrounded and arrested. After a second unsuccessful expropriation, Topilin was arrested on August 22nd, with other underground anarchists. He was charged with organising the Ryazan escape and with banditry (participation in a raid at the Smolensky Market in Moscow). He was moved to Lefortovo Prison on 1st, October, sentenced to death by the Cheka on the same day, and most likely shot very soon after.

Ovsyannikov, Sergey. Anarchy and Theatre, Theatre and Anarchy: G.S. Khodes, E.P. Garin, and I.A. Charin’s engagements with the anarchist movement during the Russian Revolution (1917-1921) and its aftermath (in Anarchist Developments in Cultural Studes, 2025, 1.

title: Internationale situationniste - Nos buts et nos méthodes dans le scandale de Strasbourg
content:
Auteur·e

: Internationale situationniste

Titre

: Nos buts et nos méthodes dans le scandale de Strasbourg

Date

: 1967

Notes

: Revue

Internationale situationniste

 n°11, octobre 1967


 Les diverses manifestations de stupeur et d’indignation qui ont fait écho à la brochure situationniste

De la misère en milieu étudiant

, publiée aux frais de la section strasbourgeoise de l’Union Nationale des Étudiants de France, si elles ont eu l’effet opportun de faire lire assez largement les thèses contenues dans la brochure même, ne pouvaient manquer d’accumuler les contresens dans l’exposé et le commentaire de ce qui a été l’activité de l’I.S. en la circonstance. En face des illusions de tous genres entretenues par des journaux, des autorités universitaires, et même un certain nombre d’étudiants irréfléchis, nous allons maintenant préciser ici quelles ont été exactement les conditions de notre intervention, et rappeler quels buts nous poursuivions par les moyens qui nous ont paru y correspondre.


 Plus erronée même que les exagérations de la presse, ou de certains avocats adverses, sur l’ampleur des sommes que l’I.S. aurait saisi l’occasion de piller dans les caisses du malheureux syndicat d’étudiants, se trouve être cette information aberrante, dont les récits journalistiques ont fréquemment fait état, selon laquelle l’I.S. aurait pu s’abaisser à faire campagne devant les étudiants de Strasbourg, pour les persuader de la validité de ses perspectives, et pour faire élire un bureau sur un tel programme. Pas davantage, nous n’avons entrepris le moindre noyautage de l’U.N.E.F., en y glissant secrètement des partisans. Il suffit de nous lire pour comprendre que tels ne peuvent être nos champs d’intérêt, ni nos méthodes. En fait, quelques étudiants de Strasbourg vinrent nous trouver, pendant l’été de 1966, et nous firent savoir que six de leurs amis – et non eux-mêmes – venaient d’être élus comme direction de l’Association étudiante locale (A.F.G.E.S.), sans programme d’aucune sorte, et en dépit du fait qu’ils étaient notoirement connus dans l’U.N.E.F. comme des extrémistes en désaccord complet avec toutes les variantes de sa décomposition, et même résolus à tout casser. Leur élection, au reste tout à fait régulière, manifestait donc à l’évidence et le désintérêt absolu de la base, et l’aveu d’impuissance définitive de ce qui restait de bureaucrates dans cette organisation. Ceux-ci calculaient sans doute que le bureau « extrémiste » ne saurait pas trouver une quelconque expression de ses intentions négatives. C’était inversement la crainte des étudiants qui vinrent alors nous trouver ; et c’est principalement pour ce motif qu’eux-mêmes n’avaient pas cru devoir personnellement figurer dans cette « direction » : car seul un coup d’une certaine ampleur, et non quelque justification humoristique, pouvait sauver ses membres de l’air de compromission que comporte immédiatement un si pauvre rôle. Pour achever la complexité du problème, alors que les étudiants qui nous parlaient connaissaient les positions de l’I.S., et déclaraient les approuver en général, ceux qui étaient membres du bureau les ignoraient plutôt, mais comptaient principalement sur nos interlocuteurs pour définir au mieux l’activité qui pourrait correspondre à leur bonne volonté subversive.


 À ce stade, nous nous sommes bornés à conseiller la rédaction et la publication, par eux tous, d’un texte de critique générale du mouvement étudiant et de la société, un tel travail comportant au moins pour eux l’utilité de leur faire clarifier en commun ce qui leur restait confus. Nous soulignâmes en outre que le fait de disposer d’argent et de crédit était le point essentiel utilisable de la dérisoire autorité qui leur avait été si imprudemment laissée ; et qu’un emploi non-conformiste de ces ressources aurait à coup sûr l’avantage de choquer beaucoup de monde, et par là de faire mieux voir ce qu’ils pourraient mettre de non-conformiste dans le contenu. Ces camarades approuvèrent nos avis. Dans le développement de ce projet, ils restèrent en contact avec l’I.S., particulièrement par l’intermédiaire de Mustapha Khayati.


 La discussion et les premières ébauches de rédaction entreprises collectivement par ceux qui nous avaient rencontrés et les membres du bureau de l’A.F.G.E.S. – tous résolus à mener à bonne fin cette affaire – apportèrent au plan une importante modification. Tous se montraient d’accord sur le fond de la critique à produire, et précisément sur les grandes …

author: Unknown
title: Мария Замир - Слон экоцида: Что убивает природу?
content:
Автор

: Мария Замир

Название

: Слон экоцида: Что убивает природу?

Дата

: 17.06.2026


Слон экоцида: Что убивает Природу?


 Глобальный экоцид – повсеместное уничтожение Природы – это катастрофа, от которой больше нигде нельзя скрыться. Естественная среда под атакой везде: в городах и пригородах, в деревнях и в самых диких лесах, на горных вершинах, в океанах и заповедниках. Этот процесс не останавливается ни на минуту. Мира, каким он был до начала войны с ним цивилизации, больше не существует, а то, что чудом сохранилось в виде оазисов, сейчас безжалостно истребляется. При этом большинство людей не имеют никакого понятия о том, что живут в погибающем мире и что дикой природы почти не осталось, не знают они ничего и о роли биосферы в поддержании жизни. И у них нет никакого желания что-то знать и тем более переживать о судьбе родной планеты. Есть небольшая группа тех, кого волнует гибель Природы, но обычно они видят лишь отдельные проблемы, с которыми и надлежит бороться, такие как строительство на заповедных территориях, загрязнение среды отходами, экологическое невежество населения или беззаконие властей и бизнеса. А само явление глобального экоцида, суть этого смертоносного процесса, охватившего всю Землю, а не частные его проявления, ими не рассматривается.


 Люди, замечающие вокруг себя уничтожение Природы, но не видящие общей картины происходящего – катастрофы планетарного экоцида, – напоминают слепых из древнеиндийской притчи. Пытаясь ответить на вопрос «что такое слон?», каждый из них ощупывает лишь одну часть тела животного, но никто не понимает, что оно представляет собой как целое. Так каков же он как целое – «слон» экоцида? Или, говоря иначе, что происходит со всей планетой, с какой болезнью она столкнулась и в чём её глубинные причины? В чём суть происходящего? Что является двигателем экоцида, если свести все отдельные проблемы к единой основе? Почему уничтожают лес, почему с невиданной скоростью вымирают виды, почему всё завалено пластиком и нет чистых рек, почему даже заповедники находятся под угрозой?


 Здесь уместно вспомнить ещё одного неузнанного слона, на сей раз из английской идиомы «elephant in the room» (дословно «слон в комнате») – о какой-то явной проблеме, которую невозможно не замечать, но о которой присутствующие не говорят, потому что это неприятно или не принято в обществе. Это выражение отлично описывает тот факт, что слона могут не видеть в упор не только слепые, но и вполне зрячие, по крайней мере, физически, и такая умственная слепота возможна для всего социума в целом, что мы и наблюдаем в нашем мире сегодня. Природа исчезает везде, на глазах у всех, но люди этого

не видят

, потому что причина её исчезновения хоть и очевидна, но слишком некомфортна для осознания, а потому о ней не говорят (и не думают).


 Так что это за слон такой в нашей планетарной «комнате»? Что это за деятельность, которая уничтожает Природу каждый день, в любой части мира, и которую упорно «не замечают», предпочитая говорить о зелёных технологиях, устойчивом развитии или экологичном образе жизни? Она настолько привычна, что стала невидимой, как воздух, который везде и о котором никто не думает – им просто дышат и всё. И в то же время она составляет самую суть цивилизации, является первоосновой её существования и главным отличием от природоцентричных культур.


 Деятельность эта –

природозамещение

: замещение Природы цивилизацией и её искусственной оболочкой – техносферой (сферой рукотворных объектов и трансформированных территорий). Эта среда пригодна только для существования в ней человека и глубоко антагонистична по отношению к биосфере, паразитирует на ней и её разрушает.


Замещение Природы собой

 – это то, для чего и чем живет цивилизация, что отражено в повестках, планах и целях всех без исключения стран и обозначается эвфемизмом «хозяйственное освоение территорий», то, чем она определяется и гордится. Любое государство, как и вся цивилизация в целом, – это сверхмощная машина переработки естественных экосистем в техносферу, в мир убитой и переделанной Природы.


 В логике цивилизации на Земле существуют две глобальные системы, потенциально способные управлять жизнью: Природа – то, что было изначально и возникло само по себе, и она сама – структура, созданная человеком. Природа в мифе цивилизации – это сила неразумная, неуправляемая, опасная, бесцельная, совершенно непригодная для жизни человечества в своем нетрансформированном виде и вдобавок к этому – некомфортная, неудобная, не ставящая …

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "Modern-Day Poll Tax": Dem. Texas Commissioner Slams GOP Vote to Close 92 Polling Sites
content:
Ahead of the November midterm elections, Republican officials in the third most populous county of Texas have voted to slash the number of polling sites by nearly one-third. Tarrant County, which includes Fort Worth, will have just 224 polling sites for 1.3 million voters. The change was approved in a party-line vote Tuesday, with all three of the county’s Republican commissioners voting in favor and the two Democrats opposing it. Civil rights groups including the

ACLU

 and

NAACP

 warn the changes will disproportionately affect voters of color.


“The eyes of the nation are on Tarrant County,” says Roderick Miles Jr., a Democratic Tarrant County commissioner, who calls the voting restriction a “modern-day poll tax.”

author: Jesse Staniforth
title: First bowhead whale harvest since 2022 brings Iqaluit abundant meat
content:
On a recent Sunday evening, Joseph Murdoch-Flowers got word that meat from the first bowhead whale hunted in four years would be arriving in Iqaluit.


 

“I rallied up my family,” Murdoch-Flowers told APTN News, “and I said, ‘Let’s go get some maktaaq.’”


 

Murdoch-Flowers is the executive director of the Qajuqturvik Community food centre, an expanded soup kitchen that serves meals in Iqaluit every weekday.


 

Last September, he was one of those who led the call to acknowledge an ongoing hunger emergency in Iqaluit — and across Nunavut — following the federal government’s decision to stop the $90-million Hamlet Food Voucher Program in 2025. 


That program provided families with $500 per month, per child under 18, plus an additional $250 monthly diaper allowance for children under 4. Since its termination, Murdoch-Flowers and others have noted a striking increase in the number of Iqaluit residents eating at Qajuqturvik.


 

For almost a year, Murdoch-Flowers has been one of the faces demanding more food and greater access to country food for Nunavummiut. 


Now tens of thousands of pounds of whale were arriving at the Iqaluit causeway, a wide coastal area with boat launches and room for community events. He and his family went to the food centre, where they grabbed some bins and a knife. Then they went down to the causeway.


 

“There was tons of it,” he said. “It was amazing to see how much was there. So we got four bins full, and then I brought it back to the food center, and I told my staff, ‘I want you to give this out tomorrow.’”


Joseph Murdoch-Flowers, executive director of Iqaluit’s Qajuqturvik Food Centre, gathers maktaaq in the causeway area on Aug. 23. Photos: Joseph Murdoch-Flowers.


 

Qajuqturvik has country-food specialists who cut the maktaaq — strips of whale-skin and blubber — into half-kilo pieces, which they served to diners alongside that Monday’s meal of BBQ chicken, pizza and salad (or chicken-noodle soup for takeout).


 

“It’s just beautiful the way that they cut it,” he said. “Then the uqsuq that we had left over, the fat. We got it vacuum-sealed and put it in the freezer for people to take as they want. And there’s still some left. And then some of the other uqsuq, our country-food staff is turning it into misiqaaq, which is the fermented fat. So that’s processing right now in the refrigerator.”


 

Murdoch-Flowers was delighted by the atmosphere at the causeway, to which people were coming from all over Iqaluit to share in the abundance of maktaaq.


 

“The sense of community and joy and pride that was there was really overwhelming,” he told APTN. “It was really beautiful to see how people were so excited to get maktaaq, and so proud of the hunters who got it. 


“There was a real feeling of coming together, just at the causeway to get this maktaaq, and then eventually to share it at the Food Center as well. It was a beautiful community experience, and we’re just so happy that we were able to provide that to the community.”


 

The captain


Solomon Awa is one of the most recognizable faces in Iqaluit, and not just because he’s the mayor. In cameos as an Elder named Lazarus on the hit APTN/CBC/Netflix series

North of North

, he’s gone viral with viewers for

his advice to a lovelorn young Inuk

: “bring her meat.”


When the Amaruq Hunters and Trappers Association began planning the first bowhead hunt in the community since 2022 and asked hunters to volunteer for roles, Awa put his name down for captain. 


It was the third bowhead expedition he’s captained since 2011, when he led hunters to harvest their first bowhead in a century. That hunt broke the ice after decades of strict bans on bowhead hunting that followed the whaling industry’s near-destruction of the species by the early 1900s.


For this year’s hunt, Awa was one of only a few experienced hunters among the team of more than 30 who planned and carried out the harvest.


“Most of these hunters, our crew, are new,” he said. “Only a few of them are experienced, maybe two or three people. Myself and my co-captain, he was the co-captain before and I was captain twice before. There’s a couple of guys, at least one I know that he had been hunting with us before. So he also talked about his experience in the meeting and the preparation.”


This handing down of experience mirrored the 2011 hunt, when Awa and others discussed well in advance how to face the challenge of the first bowhead hunt in 100 years.

author: Jesse Staniforth
title: Un policier du Nunavik accusé d’agression avec une arme : BEI
content:
Le

Bureau des enquêtes indépendantes

(BEI)

 a annoncé le 31 août qu’un agent du Service de police du Nunavik (SPN) avait été inculpé d’un chef d’accusation pour voies de fait et d’un autre pour voies de fait armé.


L’agent Raphaël Bernier a dû répondre de ces accusations devant le tribunal de Kuujjuarapik le 31 août, à la suite d’un incident survenu en août 2025 dans la communauté inuite d’Umiujaq, dans la région du Nunavik.


Radio-Canada

 a rapporté que ces accusations faisaient suite à des informations fournies au BEI par un autre agent du NPS, et que Bernier avait été suspendu de ses fonctions et placé en assignation à résidence.


Dans son bref communiqué sur ces accusations, le BEI a précisé que « Cette enquête a été menée dans le cadre du mandat du BEI pour toutes les allégations de nature criminelle visant des policiers, dans tous les cas où la victime, le plaignant ou la plaignante, est membre des Premières Nations ou des Inuits. »


Le BEI a pour mission d’enquêter lorsque toute personne autre qu’un policier en service décède, est gravement blessée ou subit des blessures par arme à feu lors d’une intervention policière ou pendant sa garde à vue. L’organisme enquête également sur les allégations de crimes sexuels commis par des policiers dans l’exercice de leurs fonctions.


Le BEI a également précisé dans son communiqué qu’au 31 mars 2025, il avait engagé des poursuites dans 31 affaires concernant des allégations criminelles à l’encontre de policiers.


The post

Un policier du Nunavik accusé d’agression avec une arme : BEI

 appeared first on

APTN News

author: Unknown
title: Number of those imprisoned in Gülistan Doku investigation rises to 32
content:
As part of the reopened investigation into the disappearance of Kurdish student Gülistan Doku in Dersim (Turkish: Tunceli), a further wave of detentions took place last week. While dozens of people are already being held in pre-trial detention on suspicion of an alleged femicide and its organized cover-up, new investigative findings have now led authorities to additional public officials and people within their circles.


Among those detained last Saturday were Ali Kahraman, who at the time of Doku’s disappearance was deputy commander of the Tunceli Provincial Gendarmerie, and his wife, Burçin Hızlı Kahraman. Three police divers who took part in the search operations at the time were also detained, along with five other people.


Ali Kahraman and his wife, Burçin Hızlı Kahraman, were remanded in custody on Thursday.


Vehicle passes viaduct shortly after Doku was last captured on camera


According to the new investigative findings, particular attention is being paid to a vehicle that was traveling across the Sarı Saltuk Viaduct on January 5, 2020. Gülistan Doku, who was 21 years old at the time, was last captured by a surveillance camera there at around 12:25 p.m. Nearly two minutes later, a vehicle rented by Halkbank reportedly crossed the viaduct. The vehicle is said to have been at the disposal of Burçin Hızlı Kahraman, who was working as a senior employee at the bank at the time.


Analysis of phone records also shows that at approximately the same time, Kahraman called Handan Sonel, the wife of then-Tunceli Governor Tuncay Sonel and mother of the main suspect, Mustafa Türkay Sonel, who is currently being held in custody as part of the ongoing investigation. A total of 536 phone contacts between the two were identified between January 2019 and December 2022. According to investigators, Ali Kahraman was also in frequent contact with several people in the case who have since been detained. However, no direct phone contact between him and Gülistan Doku was identified.


Trip to Dersim three days before the disappearance


Further findings concern the movements of the Kahraman couple immediately before Doku’s disappearance. According to the data analyzed, the two traveled by car from Antep to Dersim on January 2, 2020. Ali Kahraman was registered alone at the state-run teachers’ guesthouse from January 3 to 5. On January 5, the day Doku was last seen, Kahraman and his wife left the city and headed back toward Antep.


The significance of these movement and communication records in relation to Doku’s disappearance remains part of the ongoing investigation.


In their statements to the prosecutor’s office, the Kahraman couple claimed that they had not seen Gülistan Doku, had not taken her into their vehicle and had no connection to the incident.


Prosecutors also questioned Ali Kahraman, who was found to have provided Tuncay Sonel with “cell tower information,” about why he had sent Sonel an image of an Excel spreadsheet titled “cell tower information with residential areas.”


Kahraman claimed that he had not prepared the information himself, saying that Sonel had sent him a message stating that cell tower data was urgently needed. He said that he was in Dersim although he was stationed in Antep at the time, and that at Sonel’s request, he obtained the relevant information from gendarmerie personnel and forwarded it to him.


As part of the investigation, prosecutors also asked Kahraman, who was responsible for “mixed teams and village guards” during his tenure, whether Tuncay Sonel had given him or the guards any instructions concerning Gülistan Doku.


Kahraman claimed that he had received no such instructions from Sonel and that he himself had not given the guards any unlawful orders.


Referring to Sonel, Kahraman said: “I believe Tuncay Sonel was capable of exerting control over the guards and manipulating them. That was the kind of character he had; he was skilled at persuading and manipulating people and managing perceptions.”


Three more police divers detained


The investigation has also been expanded to include the search operations conducted at the time in the Munzur River. According to the latest findings, a total of six divers were involved in the search for Doku. Cengizhan Aydoğan and Necmi Acar had already been detained during earlier stages of the investigation, while Ramazan Karadeniz was placed under judicial control. author: Unknown
title: Woman detained in Seqiz, three women sentenced in Isfahan
content:
The Hana Human Rights Organization published a report on the repression and persecution of women by the Iranian regime.


According to the report, forces affiliated with the Intelligence Organization of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC Intelligence) entered the village of Kesnezan, in Seqiz, on Tuesday (September 1) with six vehicles. The forces detained a 48-year-old woman, Nahid Kesnezani, beating her and without a court order.


It was reported that regime forces spread throughout the village when Nahid Kesnezani was detained, prevented anyone from leaving their homes, and pressured her family in an attempt to seize her personal belongings.


Three more women sentenced


According to the report, three women protesters, Terane Rehimi, Rumina Rehimi and Sitayiş Seidi, were sentenced to prison and death by the Isfahan Revolutionary Court. All three women are reportedly being held at Dolat Abad Prison in Isfahan.


Terane Rehimi was sentenced to death and 11 years in prison, Rumina Rehimi to 25 years in prison, and Sitayiş Seidi to five years in prison.

author: Lilli Akpaleeapik
title: Government recalls cheese product for possible listeria contamination
content:
The Canadian Food Inspection Agency has recalled a cheese product due to a possible listeria contamination.


The recall, issued Tuesday, is for Coaticook’s aged cheddar cheese, with a best before date of Aug. 3, 2027.


Listeria monocytogenes is bacteria that causes a type of infection known as listeriosis. It can cause vomiting, fever, muscle aches, headaches and neck stiffness, according to a public service announcement from the territorial Department of Health.


Contaminated food may not appear spoiled, but it can still cause sickness, the statement said. Nunavummiut should throw out the product or return it to the store they bought it from.


Pregnant women, elders and residents with compromised immune systems are particularly at risk, according to the statement.


The Government of Nunavut advises residents to call their local health centre if they have become ill after consuming the product.

author: mini-DebConf Switzerland
title: Immutable Debian systems using shim and systemd-boot
content:
by Tobias Deiminger


At: MiniDebConf Winterthur 2026


https://ch2026.mini.debconf.org/talks/17-immutable-debian-systems-using-shim-and-systemd-boot/


Immutable systems are a state-of-the-art response to certain security threats for embedded systems. While secure boot only verifies the boot chain up to (and including) Linux, immutable systems additionally verify the integrity of the root file system (RFS) with all applications. A pattern using dm-verity was made popular in the embedded industry by related work from e.g. Jan Kiszka, Christian Storm

[1]

[2]

 and Manuel Traut

[3]

. More recently, new specifications like shim SBAT and UKI add-ons have emerged, enabling a more maintainable workflow and new features:


The dm-verity roothash can be deployed as a cmdline snippet in a separately signed UKI add-on. This decouples main UKI generation from roothash signing which allows for more maintainable CI-based signing workflow.


SBAT can be used for rollback protection of boot components. Since the roothash is wrapped in a UKI add-on, this rollback protection can be extended to the whole RFS.


Enrolling UEFI keys to the device during manufacturing process.


swupdate integration of systemd-bless-boot to mark successful updates and trigger automatic rollback on failure.


The talk demonstrates the setup of such a system from building it using the ELBE RFS build tool, pulling from Debian trixie, signing all parts, provisioning key material, updating to a new version and revoking a certain boot component version.


It will be presented taking QEMU as an exemplary target system, but can be adapted to a broad range of real embedded targets thanks to UEFI or U-Boot's UEFI emulation on boards without native UEFI firmware.


For production usage, signing locally is usually not an option. Therefore the talk also demonstrates how to reuse Debian's signing-templates workflow in manufacturer's CI outside Debian infrastructure using the small opensighub wrapper tool.


References


Embedded Linux Conference 2022 – Implementing UEFI-based Secure Boot + OTA Update for Embedded ARM Devices


FOSDEM 2025 – Generating immutable, A/B updatable, securely booting Debian images


All Systems Go! 2024 – Booting an embedded system like a PC

title: Trabzonspor'un yeni transferi Franculino Dju, şehre geldi
content:
Trabzonspor’un Danimarka ekibi Midtjylland’dan kadrosuna kattığı 22 yaşındaki santrfor Franculino Gludo Dju, özel uçakla Trabzon’a geldi. Bordo-mavili taraftarlar, yeni transferi Trabzon Havalimanı’nda coşkuyla karşıladı.

Transfer çalışmalarını sürdüren Trabzonspor’un kadrosuna kattığı 22 yaşındaki Gine-Bissaulu santrfor Franculino Gludo Dju, saat 17.00 sıralarında özel uçakla Trabzon’a geldi. Bordo-mavili taraftarlar, havalimanı çıkışında genç futbolcuya yoğun ilgi gösterdi. Taraftarların sevgi gösterilerine karşılık veren Franculino Dju, basın mensuplarına açıklamalarda bulundu.

Trabzon’da bulunmaktan dolayı mutlu olduğunu belirten Dju, “Burada olmaktan dolayı çok mutluyum. Trabzonspor’a geldiğim için kendimi çok iyi ve çok mutlu hissediyorum” dedi.

Transfer sürecine ilişkin konuşan Dju, “Kulüp benimle iletişime geçti. Kulübün bana söyledikleri çok hoşuma gitti. Bu yüzden buraya gelmeyi tercih ettim” ifadelerini kullandı.

Trabzonspor’daki hedeflerine ilişkin de konuşan 22 yaşındaki santrfor, “Ben buraya katkı vermeye geldim. Burada elimden gelenin en iyisini yapmaya çalışacağım” diye konuştu.

Bordo-mavili taraftarlarla buluşmasının ardından Franculino Dju, kendisini bekleyen özel araçla havalimanından ayrıldı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Fozzie
title: Echomedia Germoney #7 October 1986
content:
Article from

Znetwork

. Translated from the Swedish union paper

Arbetaren

. The author is a member of the syndicalist union

SAC

.


Author


Rasmus Hästbacka


    Submitted by

Joakim

 on September 3, 2026


 Labor lawyer Rasmus Hästbacka writes about Sweden’s supposedly strong legal protection for workers.


I often find myself

 in grim negotiations where the employer has already decided to fire workers because they’ve suffered workplace injuries or illnesses – or because they’re union activists or health-and-safety delegates. In such situations, the employer doesn’t care one bit about the Swedish Employment Protection Act, abbreviated LAS. Workers are offered a “voluntary” buyout under the threat of a forced buyout. How does that work?


First, you need to understand that firing people in Sweden has never been difficult – at least not legally, only financially costly in some cases. Under

Section 39 of LAS

, employers can always dismiss workers and then buy them out against their will. Even if you’re fired in violation of the law, and even if a court rules that the employer broke the law, the employer can simply buy their way out of the verdict by paying the damages specified in Section 39. In short, the law literally states that money stands above the law.


A forced buyout therefore means that you lose your job even if you win in court. The very name of the law – the

Employment Protection Act

 – is therefore somewhat misleading. A more accurate name would be the

Law on Employers’ Right to Fire Workers on Any Grounds They Please

.


Since all Swedish unions

 know how Section 39 of LAS works, it’s rarely worth pursuing a legal dispute all the way to a verdict. Instead, it becomes a negotiation over the price of the “voluntary” buyout.


Even when unions are prepared to fight all the way to a verdict, it’s rare that the affected workers can endure the process. Fired workers must find a new job or try to support their families on unemployment benefits (if that’s even possible). Mentally, it can be extremely tough to both fight in court over the old job and try to start a new one. It’s also not uncommon for employers to harass workers and break down their confidence, after which the worker accepts a shamefully low offer.


Thus, buyouts usually end up far lower than the damages workers could have received in court.


Under Section 39 of LAS, dismissed workers are entitled to at least 6 and at most 32 months’ salary, depending on how long they’ve been employed. The last time I sat in one of these grim negotiations, the fired worker received 150,000 Swedish kronor (approximately 15,600 US dollars). In the case before that, we managed to secure 12 months’ salary. And the case after that resulted in 17 months’ salary. That’s unusually good – but still far too low, considering the worker shouldn’t have been fired at all.


In short, the law literally states that money stands above the law.


So, how should unions

 approach these dirty negotiations? Some syndicalists argue that you should always say NO to buyouts. I understand the sentiment, but employers can still fire and buy people out regardless.


I think we should dispel all illusions that Sweden’s legal system can save people’s jobs. The law can help fired workers “own the narrative” to some extent. More precisely, when workers apply for new jobs and are asked whether they were fired from their previous one, they can answer: “Yes, but the employer violated LAS and paid damages for it.” The law can also provide a band-aid through damages – but saving workers’ jobs requires other methods.


Rasmus Hästbacka

title: Rawest'ten Bahçeli'nin sözleri sonrası Amedspor araştırmasına ilişkin açıklama
content:
Kürt çalışmaları alanında araştırmalar yürüten Rawest Araştırma, Kamuoyu ve Sosyal Araştırmalar Merkezi (KSC) ile birlikte hazırladığı Amedspor araştırmasına ilişkin açıklama yaptı.

Rawest’in sosyal medya hesaplarından yayımlanan açıklamada, Türkiye’de Kürt meselesine ilişkin sürecin tarihinin önemli dönemlerinden birinin yaşandığı belirtildi.

Açıklamada, Rawest ve KSC’nin süreci başından bu yana takip ettiği ve katkı sunmaya çalıştığı ifade edildi.

Amedspor’a ilişkin yürütülen futbol araştırmasının, sporun toplumsal bütünleşmenin güçlenmesine katkı sağlayabileceğini ortaya koyduğu belirtilen açıklamada, kulübün toplumsal ilişkilerin ve beraberliğin güçlendirilmesinde önemli bir köprü olduğu vurgulandı.

Açıklamada, MHP Genel Başkanı Devlet Bahçeli’nin araştırmaya ilişkin açıklamasının çalışmanın amacının yanlış anlaşıldığını gösterdiği savunuldu.

Rawest ve KSC, “bu yanlış anlaşılmayı düzeltmeyi bir sorumluluk” olarak gördüklerini belirtti.

Rawest tarafından yapılan açıklamanın tamamı şöyle:

“Ülkemiz Kürt sorununda tarihinin en önemli süreçlerinden birini yaşıyor. KSC ve Rawest olarak, ortak geleceğimizin teminatı olacağına inandığımız bu süreci başladığı günden beri izliyor, katkı vermeye çalışıyoruz.

Bu amaçla, süreç başladığından bu yana çeşitli etkinlikler düzenledik ve davet edildiğimiz ilgili TBMM komisyonuna katılarak bilgi ve görüşlerimizi paylaştık. Yakın zamanda yürüttüğümüz futbol araştırması, sporun toplumsal bütünleşmemizin güçlenmesine önemli bir katkı sağlayacağını gösteriyor ve Amedspor'un toplumsal ilişkilerin ve beraberliğin güçlenmesinde önemli bir köprü olduğunu teyit ediyor.

Ekim 2024'ten bugüne sağduyusu ve aldığı inisiyatiflerle sürecin başlamasına ve başarıyla ilerlemesine öncülük eden Sayın Devlet Bahçeli'nin açıklaması, araştırmamızın maksadının aksine ve yanlış anlaşılmış olduğunu gösteriyor. Sürecin başından itibaren mesaisinin önemli bir kısmını toplumsal barışa ayıran kurumlar olarak bu yanlış anlaşılmayı düzeltmeyi bir sorumluluk sayıyoruz.”

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Doğal gaz işlem hacminde gerileme
content:
Duygu Ayber Gültekin [email protected]

Enerji Piyasaları İşletme AŞ (EPİAŞ) verilerinden derlenen bilgilere göre, piyasadaki toplam işlem hacmi 4 milyon 949 bin 315 lira olarak gerçekleşti. Bir önceki gün 5 milyon 855 bin 547 lira seviyesinde bulunan işlem hacminde böylece bir miktar gerileme görüldü.

Gün boyunca piyasada toplam 287 bin metreküp doğal gaz ticareti yapılırken, piyasa dengelenme mekanizması kapsamında uygulanan alış fiyatı 18 bin 107 lira 25 kuruş, satış fiyatı ise 16 bin 382 lira 75 kuruş şeklinde netleşti.

Aynı dönemde Türkiye'nin ulusal iletim şebekesine giren toplam doğal gaz miktarı 101 milyon 336 bin 915 metreküp olurken, piyasaya sunulan (çekilen) miktar ise 101 milyon 292 bin 288 metreküp olarak gerçekleşti.

title: A Travagliato (BS) il Comitato contro il data center ottiene una prima vittoria
content:
I progetti per costruire nuovi data center in Lombardia e per gli allacciamenti alla rete Terna aumentano di giorno in giorno. 


Le criticità sono molteplici: i progetti non sono trasparenti e le aziende che li promuovono hanno capitale sociale irrisorio, sono progetti energivori e che implicano significativo consumo di acqua e di suolo oltre a implementare le isole di calore in un periodo in cui i blackout e le ondate di calore sono la quotidianità. Un ulteriore elemento è la questione della proprietà dei data center e gli interessi che orbitano intorno a questo genere di infrastruttura in una fase di guerra e riarmo. 


In queste ultime settimane sono nati diversi comitati spontanei di cittadini e cittadine che hanno deciso di prendere in mano la situazione e di contrapporsi a questa dinamica. In particolare a Travagliato, in provincia di Brescia, è stata ottenuta una prima parziale vittoria dei comitati con il parere contrario del Sindaco, dal quale si attende ancora un atto formale. Nel frattempo una rete regionale si sta organizzando, proiettandosi verso nuove iniziative di mobilitazione. 


Abbiamo sentito Laura 

Comitato per la Tutela dell’Ambiente Apolitico e Apartitico

 di Travagliato


Condividiamo di seguito l’appello dei Comitati diffuso dal 

Comitato Ciarlasco per la Tutela del Territorio

 (per saperne di più consigliamo la lettura di questa intervista 

qui

): 


Appello per una mobilitazione nazionale contro lo sviluppo irrazionale dei data center: «La trasformazione digitale non può essere decisa senza i territori»


Comitati e realtà territoriali lanciano un percorso di mobilitazione.


Primo appuntamento nazionale congiunto il 10 ottobre a Milano.


Perché l’Italia vuole diventare un hub europeo dei data center? E soprattutto: chi decide dove costruirli, chi ne trae i maggiori benefici e chi sostiene i costi ambientali, energetici e sociali di questa trasformazione?


A queste domande vuole rispondere il nuovo Manifesto per un movimento contro lo sviluppo irrazionale dei data center, promosso da una rete di comitati e realtà territoriali che da mesi si confrontano sui progetti in corso e previsti in Italia, con particolare attenzione alla Lombardia.


Il manifesto nasce da una precisazione fondamentale: la critica non è rivolta alla tecnologia, alla digitalizzazione o all’intelligenza artificiale in quanto tali, ma al modello economico e territoriale con cui il loro sviluppo viene oggi perseguito.


«Non siamo contro la tecnologia e non vogliamo fermare il futuro — spiegano i promotori —. Vogliamo però che la trasformazione digitale sia al servizio della società e non che siano i territori, le comunità e le persone a dover sostenere i costi di un’espansione decisa altrove».


Centinaia di progetti e una concentrazione particolarmente forte in Lombardia.


In Italia sono centinaia le richieste per la realizzazione di nuovi data center, con livelli differenti di avanzamento. La Lombardia rappresenta oggi una delle aree maggiormente interessate, con oltre la metà delle richieste indicate nel documento.


Il problema, sottolineano i promotori, non riguarda soltanto il numero degli impianti, ma anche la loro crescente dimensione e potenza: accanto ai data center tradizionali vengono proposti impianti da 25, 30 e 40 MW, spesso organizzati in grandi campus.


Le conseguenze non riguarderebbero quindi soltanto i singoli siti, ma l’intero sistema territoriale ed energetico: consumo di suolo e acqua, aumento della domanda elettrica, nuove infrastrutture di rete, stazioni elettriche e sistemi di accumulo, emissioni, rumore, isole di calore e possibili effetti sulla salute.


«Serve una valutazione cumulativa»


Uno dei punti centrali del manifesto è la richiesta di superare una valutazione esclusivamente progetto per progetto.


«Un territorio non è la semplice somma dei singoli progetti — affermano i promotori —. Se più data center insistono sulla stessa area, devono essere valutati insieme anche i consumi energetici e idrici, gli impatti climatici, il rumore, le emissioni, la pressione sulla rete elettrica e le conseguenze sulla salute».


Da qui la richiesta di introdurre strumenti di valutazione cumulativa, monitoraggio degli impatti dopo l’entrata in esercizio degli impianti e maggiore trasparenza sui progetti, distinguendo tra strutture operative, autorizzate, in costruzione, in procedimento e iniziative ancora preliminari.


Un Piano nazionale per decidere dove e perché costruire.

author: Publicación Abierta
title: Control mediante las deudas
content:
Control mediante las deudas


Publicado por Contra información el 2 de Septiembre de 2026, 10:10am


https://www.verdadypaciencia.com/2026/09/control-mediante-las-deudas.html


Como dijo James Garfield: «Quien controla la oferta monetaria de una nación, controla la nación».


«Quien controla el suministro de alimentos controla a la gente», dijo Henry Kissinger, aunque negó haberlo dicho.


Y John McCain afirmó en 2008 que «Quien controla el petróleo controla mucho más que el petróleo».


Si bien sería difícil discrepar con cualquiera de estas tres afirmaciones, hay un tema recurrente: el control.


El control es el eje central de todo. Cada guerra, cada pandemia, cada política gubernamental, cada idea descabellada que surge de un grupo de expertos globalistas.


Algunos de sus planes podrían generarles grandes ganancias, adquirir vastas tierras y recursos, e incluso matar a millones de personas para satisfacer momentáneamente su sed de sangre y sufrimiento, pero en el fondo, todo se reduce al control.


Los demonios al mando, tanto en el mundo de los conocidos y reconocibles como en el de las figuras oscuras e invisibles que los rodean, no se preocupan por acumular más dinero, oro y plata. Tienen más que suficiente de esas riquezas para vivir un millón de años.


Simplemente no quieren que tú y yo tengamos nada de eso. Porque, me guste o no, el dinero en el banco hace que uno sea menos controlable. La seguridad del efectivo en la cartera brinda la libertad de elegir y la libertad de decir no.


Para un culto obsesionado con el control, que tan solo una parte de la población pueda decir no es un problema.


Así, en las últimas décadas hemos presenciado una distribución masiva de la riqueza, de muchos a pocos.


Ningún otro periodo histórico ha facilitado tanto esta apropiación indebida de bienes valiosos como el absurdo cierre del planeta en 2020.


El diablo se siente envalentonado, o desesperado. Depende de cómo se mire.


En cualquier caso, las cosas están cambiando.


La presidenta de la UE, Ursula von der Layen, que no fue elegida democráticamente, declaró esta semana la guerra a los ahorros.


En otras palabras, declaró la guerra a la gente que tiene la capacidad financiera de ser menos controlable.


El Reino Unido anunció que las facturas de energía de la nación volverían a dispararse, ya saben, solo para asegurarse de que menos gente tenga unas cuantas libras extra para ahorrar en su fondo para “hacerme menos controlable”.


Estoy seguro de que es una coincidencia que todos estos escenarios se estén desarrollando al mismo tiempo.


Y aquí viene lo mejor.


La misma semana en que ocurrieron estos dos sucesos aparentemente inconexos, todos los medios de comunicación británicos iniciaron sus campañas de portada sobre la inminente guerra con Rusia y el servicio militar obligatorio que se requeriría para combatirla.


Los artículos detallaban minuciosamente cómo los jóvenes británicos debían negarse a luchar por una nación que claramente los odiaba, advirtiéndoles que, de lo contrario, recibirían un «castigo severo» en el futuro.


Ese castigo severo, al parecer, sería económico.


Así que, ¡buenas noticias, muchachos!, ahora pueden comprar su salvación para no ser carne de cañón del complejo militar-industrial, al mismo tiempo que… no tienen dinero.


La pobreza artificial es claramente un arma no solo para controlar su vida cotidiana, sino también para controlar si, de hecho, podrán seguir teniendo una vida cotidiana.


A los pobres los mandan a la guerra.


Una historia tan antigua como el tiempo, por supuesto, pero ahora casi todos son pobres, y casi todos van a la guerra.


Al menos eso es igualdad, supongo.


Esta técnica de hacer que la gente esté demasiado desesperada como para negarse no se limita solo al Reino Unido y Europa.


La semana pasada, The Jerusalem Post publicó un artículo titulado: «La guerra con Irán no se ganará con ataques aéreos, ¿entonces qué queda?». ¿Tropas terrestres, tal vez?


Botas estadounidenses, por supuesto. Puede que sea la guerra de Israel contra Irán, pero no enviarán las suyas. No seas ingenuo.


Es un artículo bastante descabellado que habla de cómo el pueblo estadounidense no quiere ir a la guerra con Irán. Nunca lo han querido, y parte de la razón es que saben que es la guerra de Israel y no están dispuestos a morir por ello. Al menos no otra vez.


Pero AJ Jaff, el autor del artículo, ha encontrado una solución al problema de que «los estadounidenses se niegan a morir …

author: Publicación Abierta
title: Privatización explosiva: la caja eléctrica del poder
content:
PRIVATIZACIÓN AMAÑADA: LOS HERMANOS JUAN Y PATRICIO NEUSS COMPRARON TRANSENER CON LOS FONDOS QUE LA PROPIA EMPRESA TENÍA EN SU HABER.


LA PRIVATIZACIÓN COMO RUIDO DE FONDO


En el aire de la argentina libertaria, de silencios cargados, de pasillos donde el poder se desliza como electricidad invisible, la privatización de Transener parece contaminar la atmósfera densa, viciada de inquietud. En la superficie, los números: 253 mil millones de pesos en dividendos liberados apenas horas después de que los Neuss y sus socios tomaran el control. Pero debajo, lo que late es la sensación de un truco viejo, un eco de los noventa, un capitalismo de amigos que se repite como un mantra.


El 27 de agosto, el directorio de Transener resolvió repartir esa suma monumental mediante la “desafectación parcial de la cuenta de reserva destinada al pago de futuros dividendos”. Al día siguiente, Genneia comunicó a la CNV la perfección de la transferencia de acciones.


La secuencia es precisa, burocrática, casi quirúrgica. Pero en este aire corroído por el tráfico de influencias, importa más la textura que la cronología: el murmullo de las pantallas en las bolsas del mundo, los documentos enviados a la Comisión Nacional de Valores, el zumbido de los servidores que registran la operación. Una coreografía de datos que oculta la simpleza brutal del movimiento: comprar con la caja de la propia empresa.


La privatización de Transener como metáfora de una conexión que une corrupción, amiguismo y deterioro del patrimonio nacional.


Los nuevos dueños —Genneia de Jorge Brito, Edison de los hermanos Neuss, Newsan de Cherñajovsky y Galli, Inverlat de Stanley y Salvai— aparecen como personajes de una novela coral. Cada uno con su biografía de poder, cada uno con su expansión territorial: Patagonia, Tucumán, Jujuy. La electricidad como metáfora de control, como red que atraviesa el país y conecta a los empresarios con el Estado, con los bancos, con los partidos políticos.


En el territorio de los significantes libertarios, la privatización es un escenario donde se cruzan tres notas periodísticas que denuncian lo mismo:


a) El reparto inmediato: los dividendos se liberan apenas consumada la transferencia, como si el tiempo fuera parte del truco.


b) La falla del sistema: durante la licitación, la oferta de los Neuss no aparecía, luego apareció, más alta, más conveniente. El sistema informático como personaje, como sospecha.


c) La caja heredada: los fondos acumulados cuando el Estado aún era socio, convertidos en botín privado.


La narrativa se vuelve paranoica: pantallas que muestran cifras, funcionarios que hablan de “problemas en el sistema”, empresarios que se sientan en directorios con la naturalidad de quien entra en un living. Todo parece normal, todo parece legal. Pero la atmósfera es de conspiración. Como en la novela «

Ruido de fondo

«, lo que importa no es el hecho sino la sensación de que el hecho está rodeado de un ruido que lo vuelve sospechoso.


El Estado, a través del Fondo de Garantía de Sustentabilidad de la ANSES, conserva un 19,6% de las acciones. Ese detalle introduce un matiz: el sistema previsional argentino participa del dividendo, recibe unos 49 mil millones de pesos. Pero la pregunta que flota es otra: ¿qué posición adoptaron los representantes del FGS frente a la decisión de liberar la reserva? ¿Qué análisis hicieron sobre el efecto que esa caja tenía en la valuación de Transener antes de la privatización?


En clave semiótica, la privatización de Transener es un relato sobre la electricidad como metáfora del poder contemporáneo. Líneas de 500 kV que atraviesan el país, como frases largas que atraviesan la novela. Una red invisible que conecta bancos, ministerios, empresas, familias. El reparto de dividendos es menos un movimiento contable que un gesto literario, un signo de cómo el capital se apropia de la energía acumulada, de cómo el poder se alimenta de reservas construidas en otro tiempo.


La escena final es casi cinematográfica: los Neuss, Brito, Carballo, Cherñajovsky, Galli, Salvai. Una mesa de directorio, papeles firmados, cifras que se repiten en pantallas. Afuera, el país con cortes de luz, con un sistema eléctrico que necesita inversiones. Adentro, la caja se abre y el dinero fluye. Como en «Ruido de Fondo», lo que queda es la sensación de que el verdadero escándalo no está en los números, sino en el ruido que los rodea, en la atmósfera de sospecha que convierte la privatización en un relato de poder …

This presentation is about sharing and reusing publicly available FOSS compliance material, as provided by the OSSelot project (

https://www.osselot.org/

), which requires trust in the reliability of the data. Such trust can be fostered by ensuring high quality and consistency of the data through a standardized curation process and strict review of all contributions. Jan will talk about the curation (and reviewing) process for the OSSelot project and present the resulting material as well as several methods for reuse. title: Preparations completed for the International Kurdish Cultural Festival in Dortmund on Saturday
content:
The 34th International Kurdish Cultural Festival will be held in Dortmund on September 5. Ahead of the festival, which is expected to draw large crowds from various European cities, preparations for transportation, venue arrangements, the cultural and artistic program, stands and security have been completed.


The festival will bring together various aspects of Kurdish culture, language, art, literature and folklore. Throughout the day, cultural and artistic events will take place alongside stands showcasing the work of various organizations.


This year’s festival has been dedicated by the Congress of Democratic Societies of Kurdistan in Europe (KCDK-E) and the Kurdish Women’s Movement in Europe (TJK-E) to the “Martyrs of Freedom” and will be held under the slogan “Towards a Democratic Society with Free Leader.”


Large turnout expected


Extensive plans have been made across different parts of Europe to facilitate participation in the festival. The Organizing Committee said it expects a large turnout.


In addition to Kurds living in various European countries and cities, members of other communities and different segments of society are also expected to attend the festival.


Aiming to bring together Kurds from different generations, the festival is being organized not only as a cultural event but also as a platform where the social and cultural experience accumulated in Europe over the years can come together.


Culture and art at the heart of the program


A comprehensive program reflecting various aspects of Kurdish culture will be held throughout the festival grounds. In addition to musical performances and folk dance shows, special activities will also be organized for children.


A dedicated tent for children will host a range of cultural and artistic activities. Spaces have also been set up where young people and members of different generations can showcase their work and cultural productions.


Kurdish Culture Market


One of the key sections of the festival will be the Kurdish Culture Market. Cultural products, publications and traditional works from different cities and regions will be brought together in this area.


Alongside programs featuring invited speakers, the festival also aims to showcase works related to Kurdish literature, language, art and social life.


Europe’s cultural heritage comes together


Publishing houses, writers, newspapers, language institutions, women’s and youth organizations, ecological initiatives, Heyva Sor (Kurdish Red Crescent), institutions from Rojhilat and various civil society organizations active in different European cities will set up stands at the festival.


The stands will showcase the organizations’ work, publications and cultural activities.


The festival will also feature the diverse regional traditions of Kurdish cuisine. A variety of dishes will be offered to participants, ranging from Rojava cuisine and traditional home-cooked meals to regional dishes and desserts.


In this way, alongside music and folklore, the festival aims to bring together culinary traditions from different regions, publishing, language initiatives, traditional production and community activities.


Environmental and hygiene measures at festival stands


Dozens of stands will be set up across the festival grounds. In addition to cultural and information stands, measures have been put in place to ensure compliance with environmental and hygiene standards in food areas.


As part of these measures, a decision was made to use biodegradable materials instead of plastic. All stands are expected to be fully set up by Friday evening, ahead of the festival.


Security arrangements


A comprehensive security plan has also been put in place to ensure that the festival takes place in an orderly and safe manner.


In addition to a professional security company, various federations have formed their own internal security teams. KAWA 1, FED GEL G2, Fed MED NRW, FED KURD Berlin, Dem Northern Germany, Belgium, the Netherlands and Northern France organizations will reportedly take part in the festival’s security arrangements.


Two main entrance gates have been designated at the festival grounds. At each entrance, 110 personnel are expected to carry out security checks and control duties in two shifts. Teams will also be assigned to provide stage security and monitor the parking areas and the outer perimeter of the festival grounds.


Mobile internal security teams have also been formed to respond …

title: YRK commemorates Simko Serhildan
content:
The East Kurdistan Defense Units (YRK) commemorated Simko Serhildan and those who lost their lives in the 2011 Battle of Qandil on the 15th anniversary of his death. “Through his struggle and revolutionary life, Simko shaped the principles of leadership and the direction of the freedom struggle,” the YRK Command stated. “In the person of Simko, we commemorate those who fell in the Battle of Qandil and all those who lost their lives in the revolution, and we pledge to continue their struggle. To fight along the path that Simko illuminated through his revolutionary stance and to carry forward the torch of his resistance is a great honor and responsibility for us.”


From Rojhilat to different parts of Kurdistan


Simko Serhildan, whose real name was Majid Kavian, was born in Bane in Rojhilat (East Kurdistan) in 1982 and joined the Kurdish freedom movement in 1999. The YRK places his decision in the context of the resistance of the people of East Kurdistan against the international plot targeting Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan. According to the YRK, this stance shaped the path he would subsequently follow.


“From the moment he joined the movement until his death, Simko Serhildan sought to develop himself on the basis of Apoist philosophy and to live in accordance with the legacy of the martyrs.”


YRK stated that Simko Serhildan attached great significance to every step of his revolutionary life. Over the years, he assumed various duties and responsibilities in different parts of Kurdistan.


“With his multifaceted personality, Simko embodied all dimensions of Apoist life and fulfilled every responsibility he undertook. Wherever he was active, he brought people together and established close bonds with his comrades. He fought in different parts of Kurdistan and carried out his work with great love and enthusiasm, both within society and among his comrades,” the statement said.


A defining role in the Battle of Qandil


In the final phase of his life, Simko Serhildan focused on guerrilla activities and preparations for the Revolutionary People’s War. He drew on the experience he had gained in these areas during the battle for Qandil in 2011. At the time, Iran’s Revolutionary Guards launched a large-scale offensive against the Medya Defense Zones. Simko Serhildan assumed a leading role in the defense. The YRK particularly recalled his role in shaping tactics involving small units and defensive operations conducted from tunnel systems.


“Ultimately, he combined his invaluable experience with that of his comrades and crowned the resistance against the occupation by the Revolutionary Guards with victory in the Battle of Qandil,” the statement said. Simko Serhildan lost his life during these clashes.


According to the YRK, his stance at the time is not merely part of the memory of the 2011 resistance. “The stance, leadership and command that Simko developed in this battle and throughout his life will serve as the foundation of our struggle and a guiding force for the freedom revolution.”


“Fifteen years later, the guerrilla forces in Rojhilat continue to draw on this legacy. Every fighter and every commander should continually recreate themselves in the reality of the Simkos and further develop the path of the guerrilla of democratic modernity. As the YRK Command, we declare once again that we will always follow in the footsteps of the Simkos and carry forward, without interruption, the torch of struggle of these great fallen comrades,” the statement concluded.

On the finish line after many years of school or university? Nothing beats that moment to finally hold the graduation paper in your hands. Except maybe obtaining an additional digital version. But what can you do with it, how open is the ecosystem, and will it run on Debian and its derivatives? When you dive into that topic, you come across micro-credentials and badges and wallets and blockchains and signed documents and even more to know about, and you may be confused rather than in a position to keep everything under control.


Therefore, this talks sheds some light on the recent technology developments, brings everything into order, and gives practical insights from Swiss universities and other deployments. Due to the processing of personal data, the setup and operation of VMs along with the software services on top of them needs to be well planned, and the talk informs about these aspects. Abstract


Starting with some ideas -- but also requirements -- the talk describes the development and the implementation of a Debian-based IT-solution for a middle-sized technical secondary (occupational) school.


We start with a

linuxmuster.net School-Server

, but replace the imaging-based client by a Debian KDE desktop clients deployed via PXE boot, preseeding and ansible-pull during the installation.


Proprietary, commercial/industrial software is provided by a sophisticated system of VMs. The VMs are synchronized to the local machine on demand using bittorent. Teachers and/or departments are invited to provide their own customized VM image.


The talk describes the technical concepts and a system, where students not only learn about IT, but also about digital sovereignty, collaboration, community and the power of Free and Open Source Software.
